summary: moOde Audio provides high-fidelity music playback specifically designed for Raspberry Pi single-board computers. The application runs on PHP and manages local audio files, network streams, and connected digital-to-analogue converters. It is published under the GPL-3.0 licence and caters to dedicated audio setups.
goodFor: It is well-suited for enthusiasts wanting to turn a Raspberry Pi into a dedicated, high-quality network music player connected to a stereo system.
watchOut: Hardware compatibility is strictly limited to the Raspberry Pi family, meaning it cannot be easily deployed on standard x86 servers or generic Linux hardware.
deployNotes: Because the application relies on a PHP runtime, you will typically need a standard web server configuration with appropriate audio device permissions on the host system. Persistent storage is required for your local music library and configuration state.
